description: This file provides utility functions for calculating element positions and mouse coordinates within the Notesnook project, including getPosition, getElementPosition, and mouse event handling.

methods.name: getPosition
methods.description: Calculates the position (top and left) for positioning an element relative to a target or mouse position, considering options like alignment, offsets, and boundaries.

methods.name: getElementPosition
methods.description: Returns the position data (x, y, width, height, actualX, actualY) of a given HTMLElement, optionally as an absolute position.
